digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate push operations to a single core entrypoint without inline CAS loops or retry logic.
Workflow-local fetch/merge/retry loops and the reconciler raw-git exemption must be removed while preserving bot identity and commit subject.
Core must own retry and CAS recovery; workflows remain red on exhausted delivery failure with synchronous behavior.
Reconciler and canary workflows must invoke strict push actions via rebar._store.push with full argparse-valid argument shapes (tracker, message, author-name, author-email).
Python library and MCP interfaces retain best-effort push defaults; migration affects only strict workflow adapters and does not narrow public API surface.
Standing-decision blocks and executable tests must document that core owns CAS recovery and that strict workflow delivery is synchronous and red on failure.
